description: Rill CLI lifecycle; requires trusted globally installed rill binary

hooks.command: command -v rill >/dev/null 2>&1 && rill hook session-start || true
command -v rill >/dev/null 2>&1 && rill hook pre-compact || true
command -v rill >/dev/null 2>&1 && rill hook pre-tool-use || true
command -v rill >/dev/null 2>&1 && rill hook post-tool-use || true
command -v rill >/dev/null 2>&1 && rill hook stop || true
